facts.claim: Somavarpet is a small town located 26 miles north of Mercara on the main road.
facts.quote: A small town situated in N. lat. 12° 36' E. long. 75° 55', in Nanjarajpatna taluk, on the main road 26 miles north of Mercara.

facts.claim: The highest mountain in Coorg is Tadianda mol, standing at 5,729 ft.
facts.quote: The highest mountain in Coorg (5,729 ft) situated in the south west of Padinalknad taluk.

facts.claim: Virarajendrapet is the most important commercial town in Coorg, trading coffee, rice, and cardamoms with the western coast.
facts.quote: The trade of Virarajendrapet with the western coast in coffee, rice, and cardamoms makes it the most important commercial town in Coorg.
